objective: Reproduce the original MSc dissertation model's test-set results using the original trusted model artifact and the original held-out test data, without retraining.

dataset.path: REPLACE: path to the ORIGINAL held-out test CSV (or the full CSV plus a split column)
dataset.name: REPLACE: e.g. cse-cic-ids2018
dataset.version: REPLACE: e.g. 02-14-2018 processed, as used in the dissertation
dataset.expected_sha256: REPLACE: output of `adaptive-ids hash <file>` on the backed-up original file

schema_path: REPLACE: a copy of configs/schemas/cse-cic-ids2018.candidate.json edited to the dissertation's exact feature list

model.artifact_id: REPLACE: id from the trusted manifest

reported_results.source: REPLACE: dissertation section/table where these numbers were reported

notes: If the original model was trained on scaled/encoded inputs outside a sklearn Pipeline, the original fitted scaler must also be recovered — do NOT refit it on test data. Record the gap in docs/milestone-1-status.md instead.
